caption: The drawing depicts a single grand piano with a rectangular body, colored in rich brown wood tones with darker and lighter wood grain patterns visible across its surface. The piano has a raised music stand positioned centrally on the top lid, which is also brown and constructed of thin wooden slats. There is a golden nameplate above the keyboard, accompanied by other gold decorative elements on the front panel. The piano keys are arranged in a standard alternating pattern of white and black. The body of the piano is supported by a central pedestal base, which is also brown and features gold and black decorative accents. The pedestal expands outward into four feet, each ending in a carved, paw-like foot that is dark brown. Three thin metallic pedals are positioned under the body of the piano and hang down toward the base. The background is an off-white or light beige color with some visible age-related discoloration, and there are no additional objects or scenery in the composition.
title: Piano Forte
